start: Members > Import, a file with a column 'Aadhaar No.' full of real-shaped Aadhaar numbers

user_sees: 'Other columns (locker number, blood group…) can be kept as extra details. Aadhaar and PAN numbers are never imported.'
must_not: A promise on screen that the code does not keep

user_sees: 'Not imported: Column G “Aadhaar No.” has Aadhaar numbers. ID numbers are never imported.'
The column is in no box and is not offered as an extra detail; in a column picker it is marked '(ID numbers)'
must_not: The column guessed into Notes, Mobile or an extra detail
The numbers shown to the AI column matcher (it may see only '[ID number]')

steps.action: Tap 'Add <n> members', then open one of the new members
user_sees: The member without any Aadhaar number in notes, address or extra details
must_not: An Aadhaar number stored anywhere for the member
An ID number in the 'skipped rows' download

start: Import file where the ID number sits inside a cell that is imported (a note, an address, an extra detail)

steps.action: Choose a file whose Notes say 'PAN ABCDE1234F, Aadhaar XXXX XXXX 1234'
user_sees: The row says an ID number was left out
The text reads '[ID number removed]' in place of each number
must_not: The number kept in the note
The rest of the note lost

steps.action: Choose a file with a column named 'Name as per Aadhaar' that holds names
user_sees: 'Column <X> “Name as per Aadhaar” is read as usual. Any Aadhaar or PAN number in it is left out.'
must_not: The whole column dropped because of its name

start: Import columns step, the owner picks the ID-number column by hand for a box

steps.action: In the Notes box pick the column marked '(ID numbers)'
user_sees: The column can be picked; every Aadhaar or PAN number in it is still cut, and the rows say so
must_not: The numbers imported because the owner picked the column himself

start: Import file with numbers that only look like ID numbers, and ID numbers written in odd ways

steps.action: Use a mobile written as 91 plus ten digits, and a 12-digit amount
user_sees: Both are kept as they are (not taken for an Aadhaar)
must_not: A mobile number cut out of a member
A row refused because of it

steps.action: Use an Aadhaar typed with one wrong digit, one in Hindi digits, and one written with dots between the groups
user_sees: Expected: left out like any Aadhaar. The code read cuts only 12 digits with a correct check digit, in English digits, with spaces or dashes: result unknown
must_not: A real person's Aadhaar stored because it was typed in another style

start: Import rows list with a row waiting under 'Rows to check'

steps.action: Type an Aadhaar number into a cell of the row and save the fix
user_sees: The fixed row is read again and the number is cut, with the row saying so
must_not: A number typed as a fix imported

steps.action: Finish the import, tap 'Undo this import', then import the same file again
user_sees: The same columns left out and the same numbers cut as the first time
must_not: A different result on the second import

start: A finished import of a file that held Aadhaar and PAN numbers

steps.action: Use AI column matching on the file
user_sees: The AI is shown '[ID number]' for an ID column, '[PAN]' and masked digits (first 2 and last 2) elsewhere
must_not: A full Aadhaar or PAN sent to the AI company

steps.action: Download a backup of the gym's data and search it for the numbers
user_sees: No Aadhaar or PAN number of the imported members
must_not: An ID number on the gym's server, in a backup, or visible to front desk, trainers or HQ
